utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check around and see where help is needed most, then let Mina know if donations are still needed. If I hear anything else at drop-off, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Nell. I’m on the supply list and I’ll check in with the tool folks today, so I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll ask around and pass along whatever I hear at drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive so folks know what’s needed. If you hear anything else, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll drop by the repair drive and mention it to a few neighbors too. Sam’s checking the supplies, so I’ll pass along anything folks still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep the invitations moving and point people to you if they have questions. Thanks for helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll wait for Noah’s rundown, then I’ll jump in on whatever’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — Tess said she’ll let me know what’s still needed, and I can bring a couple bins and help load things up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll wait for Noah’s rundown and then help with whatever’s still needed. Thanks, Gus; the bins will definitely help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — we can use you to sort donations or carry supplies on Sunday at the community center. I’m checking the wiring list now, and I’ll let Hana know if anything looks off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right — I can sort the donations, or help carry supplies on Sunday. And I’ll keep an eye out for small useful things and drop them by Uli’s gate.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — that’ll help a lot. I’m still checking the wiring list, and if anything looks off I’ll tell Hana.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Tess said the repair drive is still happening, right? And Leo will let Hana know if anything looks off?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — it’s still on Sunday at the community center, and I’m waiting for Leo’s wiring check before I move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on Sunday at the community center, and Leo’s wiring check is the only thing left before you move ahead?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll keep everything lined up with the school schedule. I’ll make a simple list and ask around at drop-off for anything else that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what we already have and see what’s still missing for the repair drive. If I spot any gaps, I’ll let Noah know too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — the drive’s at the community hall, so that should be easy. Let me know what’s missing, and I’ll keep everything synced with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center. Do we still need any donations, or is that covered?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We could still use donations if folks have them, but the community center is the right place on Sunday. Quinn is helping spread the word, and Noah can check in at the drive to see where help’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — I’ll tell folks donations still help. If you hear where help is needed most, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot — I can ask Gus about the bins and tools, and maybe Leo can double-check the wiring list before we start. Rey being available most afternoons should make the pickups easier too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, sounds like we’ve got it covered. Gus for the bins and tools, and I’ll keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good — then I’ll keep the pickup list tight and make sure we don’t miss anything. I’ll check with Rey for an afternoon slot and follow up on Gus’s tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the supplies and note anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam — Gus is checking what we already have, and I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll compare that with what’s on hand and write down any missing supplies. Once you have the time and place, send it over and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll start the list and jot down the tools we already have for the repair drive. I’ll swing by again, repeat the plan, and bring a few tools to help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Rey. Keep the list handy, and I’ll stick to the plan when I stop by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll keep the list handy and note the tools we have. I’ll bring a few tools by and repeat the plan when I swing through.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center — got it. Cleo’s checking the supplies, and I can ask around to see where help’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. That’d help a lot — just let me know where you’re needed most.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do — I’ll ask around once folks start gathering and let you know where I’m needed most.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Cleo’s going to check what we already have and what’s still needed, and Gus said he can lend a few tools. Oren and Ira are helping too, and Gus can bring a couple bins and help load everything up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful—thank you. We’re still set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep checking the hall first, then the corner garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, that sounds like a solid plan. I’ll pass the word along and keep an ear out if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what we already have and list what’s still missing for the repair drive. Then I can tell Noah what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll drop by the repair drive, mention it to a few neighbors, and pass the remaining repair tasks along to Jules.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll keep sorting the supplies and let Noah know what’s still missing. Thanks for helping spread the word and pass the tasks to Jules.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center — thanks for the reminder. Cleo’s checking supplies, and I’ll ask around at the drive to see where help’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll ask around too and check whether donations are still needed. If I hear where help is needed most, I’ll let Mina know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — thanks, Nell. I’ll do the same at the community center on Sunday and see where folks need a hand most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still waiting on your wiring check before I move ahead. Once you send the report, Hana can go next too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m checking the wiring list now and I’ll let Hana know right away if anything looks off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — send me the wiring report when you’ve got it, and Hana can follow up after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the supplies and jot down anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good plan — let’s make the list first, then we can decide what to fix today and what can wait.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll make the list of what we still need, then we can sort today’s fixes from the ones that can wait.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, the repair drive is still on. I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—please send Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep the volunteers and supplies lined up, and I’ll wait for Leo’s wiring check before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll send Sunday at the community center once I have the final details. Thanks for keeping the volunteers and supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll keep it lined up with the school schedule and make a simple list for anything else that needs fixing at drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you tell me if anything still needs doing for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check around and let you know if anything’s still needed for Sunday at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll wait for Noah’s rundown and then jump in on whatever’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works — I’m keeping an eye on the drive locations, so I’ll let you know where the gaps are. Noah can check in there and point us to where help’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — once Noah gives the rundown, I’ll fill in wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a few tools, and I can bring a couple bins to help load everything up. Tess can let me know what’s still needed as soon as she hears.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right? Tess confirmed that?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on as far as I know — Tess hasn’t updated me yet, but she said she’d let me know what else the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Let me know if there’s anything specific you want included in the invite.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Quinn — just mention Sam’s still helping, and I’ve got the remaining tasks from Vik to share. Also, Gus has a few tools Pia can borrow if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll mention Sam’s still helping and that you’ve got the remaining tasks from Vik. I’ll also note Gus’s tools are available for Pia if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — Leo can follow up with Vik and Pia, and check the wiring list for Hana too. Oren can sort donations or help carry supplies, and Noah’s on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that covers a lot. Gus is still able to lend a few tools and bring a couple bins to help load things up, and I’ll keep Gus and Kira posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, that should keep things moving. Thanks for keeping Gus and Kira in the loop — I’ll stay ready if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can sort the donations or help carry supplies for the repair drive—whatever you need most. I may need a quick reminder, but I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — could you help carry supplies and sort donations on Sunday at the community center? If you need a reminder, I’ll send one over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, Sunday at the community center works for me. A reminder would help, and I’ll sort donations and carry supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll start the list and jot down the tools we already have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps, Rey. Sunday at the community center is still the plan, and it’s good to know the tools are getting sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep the list tidy and add anything else we confirm. With Oren watching for small useful things and Sam checking what’s still missing, we should be in good shape.
